metadata.stream_basis: Complete Chartmetric export by exact ISRC, supplemented with exact-ISRC Spotify track counters. Headline is a conservative minimum: maximum available Spotify counter per normalized title + credited artist set; remix/speed/version words are retained. All ISRCs remain in the ledger. Counters can overlap across reissues and platform-linked versions; headline is not a precise all-time royalty statement. Missing counters are excluded, never replaced with zero.

identity_basis: Instagram @yungwolf_1, the Wolfpack Global Music releases and the verified Spotify profile agree. Label metadata alternates Maricus Taylor and Maricus Traylor. The preferred legal spelling and primary IPI remain to be verified.

findings.title: Five compositions support a focused attribution review.
findings.body: Your legal writer names are evidenced on 5 unique compositions, spanning 5 reviewed recordings. No positive MLC publisher/admin claim whose own writer chain names that identity was identified on those five. The works are “Made Me,” “Don’t Bother Me,” “Printed By the Pack,” “Hold Da Pain In” and “By 2MR.” This is an apparent collection-attribution gap, with exact entitlement and current representation to be verified from agreements.

findings.title: Two existing works need recording-link verification.
findings.body: “HOLD DA PAIN IN” H31S4P shows 25% total known shares; “BY 2MR” BJ1PHZ shows 6.25%. Both name MARICUS TAYLOR. The Kobalt-administered Artist 101 claim names co-writer Liam Barry McAlister. Direct searches did not confirm the reviewed ISRCs on these works. Verify the composition/version and attach the recordings to the correct existing work rather than filing a duplicate.

findings.title: Open shares are visible, but the remainder is not your split.
findings.body: “MADE ME” MN9B3Y shows 16.67% known shares, “PRINTED BY THE PACK” PO4FLV 8.34%, and “DON’T BOTHER ME” DS0YWZ 25%. The first two have publisher rows whose own writer lists are empty, so attribution remains unresolved. On “Don’t Bother Me,” the visible BeatStars/Sentric and United Market/EMPIRE claims explicitly name other writers. Verify your split and administration history before proposing any claim.

findings.title: Resolve Taylor, Traylor and stage-name writer records first.
findings.body: Label and registry sources use MARICUS TAYLOR, MARICUS TRAYLOR and MARICUS JR TRAYLOR; the last appears on “Don’t Bother Me” with IPI 01191748923. Confirm that IPI and preferred legal spelling in your own account. The shared Deezer profile also returned 143 other or unverified same-name recordings, excluded from client totals. Stage-name-only writer records are flagged for identity verification rather than automatically treated as your legal writer evidence. The off-catalog “NO EMOTION” work N99LKQ shows 0% known shares and is a possible title variant of “No Emotions”; it remains unconfirmed and outside the five-composition attribution count. Exact-ISRC Spotify checks separate the previously excluded features from other Wolf artist profiles. The Noah “MARGIELA / MAD” delivery is linked to both Atlanta and Tacoma profiles under one ISRC; it remains in the visible identity-review ledger, outside client exposure and attribution totals.

findings.title: Prioritize the current catalog without overlooking missing credits.
findings.body: The complete catalog review includes 75 recordings, with Spotify counters supplied for 71. The conservative exposure floor is 1,377,268 Spotify plays; unavailable counters are excluded, and overlapping same-title/artist versions are not added together. The per-recording streaming audit preserves every supplied counter and platform value. The catalog now includes “Throw Me Off,” “Hunnids,” “Deeper,” the Yns Corey features and their source versions, “SCENE,” and the Spotify-confirmed M1LES feature “Break Me Down.” The last has no ISRC supplied by the source catalog and remains marked for identifier verification. 41 recordings have no matching MLC work identified, while 26 have a matching work whose writer identity needs verification. Featured-artist credit alone does not establish a writing share.
